Attach data, logs and links to the report

Source: R/attachment.R
attachments.Rd

The context of a step or a hook attaches data to the report, e.g. a screenshot or what the page showed:

  • context$attach(data, media_type, file_name) attaches a string, or a raw vector, like a file read with readBin(). media_type is its media type, like "image/png" or "application/json". It defaults to "text/plain" for a string, and is required for a raw vector. file_name is the name of the file the reports offer to download it as.

  • context$log(text) attaches text to read, like a log line.

  • context$link(...) attaches one or more links. Each argument is a URL, or a character vector of URLs, and they're attached together as one attachment, like context$link("https://example.com/basket", "https://example.com/checkout") or context$link(urls).

Behavior






Feature: Attachments


A step or a hook attaches data to the report with its context: context$attach() attaches
a string or a raw vector with its media type, context$log() attaches text and
context$link() a URL. The attachments are reported as Cucumber Messages, and the reports
show them, like the HTML report. The pretty reporter prints them under their step.


Background:
  • Given a package
    • 





Scenario: A step attaches data, a log and a link
  • Given a file named "features/basket.feature" with

    Feature: Basket
  Scenario: Add an item
    When I add an item
    • 

  • And a file named "features/setup-steps.R" with
    when("I add an item", function(context) {
  context$attach('{"items": 1}', "application/json")
  context$attach(as.raw(c(1, 2, 3)), "application/octet-stream", file_name = "basket.bin")
  context$log("Added an item")
  context$link("https://example.com/basket")
})
    • 

  • When I run
    test("features")
    • 

  • Then the attachments are:
    stepmedia_typebodyencodingfile_name
    When I add an itemapplication/json{"items": 1}IDENTITY
    When I add an itemapplication/octet-streamAQIDBASE64basket.bin
    When I add an itemtext/x.cucumber.log+plainAdded an itemIDENTITY
    When I add an itemtext/uri-listhttps://example.com/basketIDENTITY

Scenario: A step attaches several links at once


Each argument of context$link() is a URL or a character vector of URLs.
They're attached together, one URL per line.
  • Given a file named "features/basket.feature" with

    Feature: Basket
  Scenario: Check out
    When I check out
    • 

  • And a file named "features/setup-steps.R" with
    when("I check out", function(context) {
  context$link("https://example.com/basket", "https://example.com/checkout")
  context$link(c("https://example.com/help", "https://example.com/terms"))
})
    • 

  • When I run
    test("features")
    • 

  • Then the attachments are:
    stepmedia_typebodyencodingfile_name
    When I check outtext/uri-listhttps://example.com/basket\nhttps://example.com/checkoutIDENTITY
    When I check outtext/uri-listhttps://example.com/help\nhttps://example.com/termsIDENTITY
    • 





Scenario: A step attaches images


Read an image, like a screenshot, with readBin() and attach it with its media type.
It's base64 encoded, and the HTML report shows it.
  • Given a file named "features/basket.feature" with

    Feature: Basket
  Scenario: Add an item
    When I add an item
    • 

  • And a file named "features/setup-steps.R" with
    read_file <- function(path) readBin(path, "raw", file.size(path))when("I add an item", function(context) {
  png("basket.png")
  plot(1:3)
  dev.off()
  context$attach(read_file("basket.png"), "image/png", file_name = "basket.png")  jpeg("basket.jpg")
  plot(1:3)
  dev.off()
  context$attach(read_file("basket.jpg"), "image/jpeg", file_name = "basket.jpg")
})
    • 

  • When I run
    test("features")
    • 

  • Then the attachments are:
    stepmedia_typeencodingfile_name
    When I add an itemimage/pngBASE64basket.png
    When I add an itemimage/jpegBASE64basket.jpg
    • 





Scenario: Hooks attach data too


before_all() and after_all() hooks get a context to attach with when they take one argument.
  • Given a file named "features/basket.feature" with

    Feature: Basket
  Scenario: Add an item
    When I add an item
    • 

  • And a file named "features/setup-steps.R" with
    before_all(function(context) context$log("Started the server"))
before(function(context, scenario) context$log("Opened the browser"))
when("I add an item", function(context) {})
after(function(context, scenario) context$attach("<html></html>", "text/html", file_name = "page.html"))
    • 

  • When I run
    test("features")
    • 

  • Then the attachments are:
    stepmedia_typebody
    BeforeAlltext/x.cucumber.log+plainStarted the server
    Beforetext/x.cucumber.log+plainOpened the browser
    Aftertext/html<html></html>
    •

Examples

    
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
when("I open the basket", function(context) {
  context$session$go_to("/basket")
  context$log("Opened /basket")
  context$link("https://example.com/basket")
})

when("I check out", function(context) {
  context$link("https://example.com/basket", "https://example.com/checkout")
})

after(function(context, scenario) {
  if (scenario$status == "failed") {
    file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    context$session$screenshot(file)
    context$attach(readBin(file, "raw", file.size(file)), "image/png", file_name = "screenshot.png")
  }
})
} # }
